description: Prep menu for the day service.
Help all our cooks in my area with dinner setup.
Delegate all our breaks throughout the shift.
Assist our Sous Chefs and Executive Chef with running dinner service.
Prep our menu for each shift.
Make sure we cook all the food for each station to operate in time for service.
Manage our assigned station making sure we are stocked with the proper items throughout each shift.
Work with the Sous Chefs, and Executive Sous chefs, and cooks to run shifts smoothly.
Make sure our assigned kitchen has the proper cook-ware each shift.
Responsible for the cleanliness of our assigned station as well as kitchen we are working at.
Provide our cooks and chefs with clean and sanitized equipment throughout each shift.
Responsible for knowing what chemicals we are working with and all safety procedures that accompany them.
Train all new kitchen cooks and dishwashers.
Keep control of the night shifts in the kitchen.

matchmaking_summary: Charles Hundley is a highly skilled and experienced chef with a strong educational background in Business Management, complemented by practical experience in the culinary field. With over nine years of overall cooking and kitchen experience, including four years as a lead cook, Charles has honed his skills through various roles and gained invaluable knowledge under top chefs from The Norwegian Cruise Line's Pride Of America. His training includes learning mother sauces, knife skills, and new kitchen terminology from Chef Frank D., Chef David Lilllis, and Chef Alan. Additionally, he has learned advanced cooking techniques from Iron Chef Michael Symon, such as smoking meats, using herbs and spices effectively to manage cooking time and work different items simultaneously. Charles' combination of theoretical business management knowledge and practical culinary skills positions him well for a career in executive chef roles.
